pdf_page_count takes the password of an encrypted PDF

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::pdf_page_count;

fn main() {
    let pdf_bytes = std::fs::read(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../test_documents/pdf/password_protected.pdf")).expect("test_documents/pdf/password_protected.pdf must exist");
    let password = Some(r#""#);
    let result = pdf_page_count(&pdf_bytes, password.as_deref());
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
